definitions.explanation: The competitive ice sport of performing jumps, spins, and choreographed movement on ice skates. Loanword from English. A widely followed winter sport in Japan, both at the Olympic level and on TV.

examples.japanese: フィギュアスケートを{見|み}るのが{好|す}きだ。
{娘|むすめ}は{5歳|ごさい}からフィギュアスケートを{習|なら}っている。
examples.english: My daughter has been learning figure skating since she was five.

examples.japanese: フィギュアスケートの{大会|たいかい}でジャンプの{回転|かいてん}が{足|た}りず{減点|げんてん}された。
examples.english: At the figure skating competition, the jump rotations were under-rotated and points were deducted.

notes:
Loanword from English "figure skating." In casual conversation it is often shortened to フィギュア — context disambiguates between the sport and the model-figurine sense of フィギュア.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- フィギュアスケートの{選手|せんしゅ}: figure skater
- フィギュアスケートの{大会|たいかい}: figure skating competition
- フィギュアスケートを{習|なら}う: to take figure skating lessons
- ペアフィギュア / アイスダンス: pairs / ice dance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- スケート: skating — the general term, includes figure skating and speed skating
- スピードスケート: speed skating — racing on a long oval track
- アイスダンス: ice dance — a related discipline focusing on dance choreography
